items.q: Cluster B personality disorders comprise which set?
items.exp: Cluster B is dramatic, emotional and erratic: antisocial, borderline, histrionic, narcissistic. Cluster A is odd eccentric; cluster C anxious fearful.
r: Incorrect. Mixes A and C members.
Correct. B dramatic set.
Incorrect. Those are cluster C.
Incorrect. Schizotypal is cluster A.
items.kp: B for theatrical storm: antisocial, borderline, histrionic, narcissistic.

items.q: First line treatment for borderline personality disorder with recurrent self-harm is what?
items.exp: DBT specifically reduces self-harm, suicide attempts and admissions in RCTs by teaching regulation skills within validating therapy frame. Drugs lack core efficacy and polypharmacy accumulates harm.
r: Incorrect. Dependence worsens impulsivity.
Correct. DBT first line.
Incorrect. No antipsychotic treats core disorder.
Incorrect. ECT targets severe mood or catatonia.
items.kp: Skills, not sedatives, for borderline storms.

items.q: Antisocial personality disorder diagnosis additionally requires evidence of what before age 15?
items.exp: DSM requires conduct disorder onset before 15 plus adult disregard pattern from 18, linking childhood aggression, rule violation and cruelty trajectories. Adult criminality alone without childhood pattern does not suffice.
r: Incorrect. Psychosis not required.
Correct. Conduct disorder before fifteen.
Incorrect. Mania is episodic mood.
Incorrect. Autism differs developmentally.
items.kp: No childhood conduct, no antisocial label.

items.q: Mood shifts in borderline disorder are best distinguished from bipolar hypomania how?
o: Borderline reactivity lasts hours and is interpersonally triggered; bipolar episodes are days to weeks more autonomous
items.exp: Borderline affective instability reacts to abandonment or rejection cues within hours returning to baseline dysphoria, while bipolar episodes sustain with neurovegetative and psychomotor change independent of triggers, guiding therapy versus mood stabilisers.
r: Incorrect. Weeks describes bipolar episodes.
Correct. Hours plus interpersonal trigger equals borderline pattern.
Incorrect. Rapid cycling bipolar exists but episodes persist days.
Incorrect. Elevation belongs to bipolar spectrum.
items.kp: Hours after rejection: personality. Weeks unprovoked: bipolar.

items.q: Which pharmacotherapy is approved to treat core borderline personality disorder itself?
items.exp: No medicine is licensed for core personality disorder; guidelines warn against polypharmacy, using time limited drugs for comorbid depression, anxiety or transient symptoms with review and stop dates.
r: Incorrect. SSRIs treat comorbid depression, not core.
Correct. No drug treats core disorder.
Incorrect. Stabilisers lack core cure evidence.
Incorrect. Depots inappropriate for personality alone.
items.kp: Therapy treats personality; pills treat passengers.

items.q: Man aloof, solitary, flat, indifferent to praise or relationships since youth, content alone, most fits which cluster A disorder?
items.exp: Schizoid personality prefers solitude with emotional coldness and no desire for closeness, unlike avoidant who wants contact but fears rejection, schizotypal with magical oddity, paranoid with mistrust.
r: Incorrect. Paranoid mistrusts rather than detaches contentedly.
Correct. Schizoid solitary detachment.
Incorrect. Schizotypal adds eccentric beliefs and perceptual oddity.
Incorrect. Avoidant longs for acceptance.

items.q: Obsessive compulsive personality disorder differs from OCD principally how?
o: Rituals are present in both equally
OCPD is ego syntonic perfectionism and control without true intrusive obsessions or compulsive rituals
items.exp: OCPD traits (orderliness, perfectionism impairing completion, work devotion, rigidity) feel right to the person (ego syntonic), while OCD intrusions are unwanted (ego dystonic) with neutralising rituals. They can coexist.
r: Incorrect. Rituals define OCD, not OCPD.
Correct. Ego syntonic perfectionism without rituals.
Incorrect. Tics relate Tourette spectrum.
Incorrect. OCD is episodic disorder, not trait label.
items.kp: Proud perfectionist is personality; tormented ritualiser is OCD.

items.q: Self-harm in borderline disorder is most accurately understood commonly as what?
o: Always manipulative attention seeking to dismiss
Often emotion regulation or self punishment, still requiring full risk assessment
items.exp: Functional analysis shows relief of unbearable affect, self punishment and communication of distress; dismissive manipulation framing harms care and misses real suicide mortality. DBT targets these functions with skills.
r: Incorrect. Stigmatising dismissal is unsafe and wrong.
Correct. Regulation function, assess risk fully.
Incorrect. Psychosis not implied.
Incorrect. DBT demonstrably reduces it.
items.kp: Cutting regulates feelings; assess, never dismiss.

items.q: Schizotypal personality features include which additions beyond schizoid detachment?
o: Magical thinking, ideas of reference, perceptual distortions and eccentric appearance
items.exp: Schizotypal sits on schizophrenia spectrum with cognitive perceptual distortions, magical beliefs and odd speech or appearance plus social anxiety, carrying genetic kinship to schizophrenia.
r: Correct. Magical eccentric distortion set.
Incorrect. Conduct belongs antisocial pathway.
Incorrect. Grandiosity is narcissistic or manic.
Incorrect. Checking is OCD spectrum.

items.q: Dependent personality core pattern is what?
o: Excessive need to be taken care of with submissive clinging and fear of separation
items.exp: Dependent personality subordinates own needs, fears making decisions or being alone, and urgently seeks new relationships when one ends, often tolerating mistreatment; therapy builds autonomy gradually.
r: Correct. Clinging care seeking dependence.
Incorrect. Detachment is schizoid or avoidant pattern.
Incorrect. Rights disregard is antisocial.
Incorrect. Perfectionism is obsessive compulsive personality.
items.kp: Cannot decide alone, clings to care: dependent.
